LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.GearAvailabl: Scales only existing beneficial offsets for curated work, movement, medical, social or psyfocus stats. Zero offsets and penalties stay unchanged; native stat limits still apply.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.NoContributi: No apparel or weapon in your game gives a bonus in this group, so there is nothing to scale. It switches on when a mod adds such gear. Stats that another mod already scales by quality are left to that mod.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.Conflict: The native consumer is missing or another mod intercepts it. This adapter leaves the consumer unchanged to avoid duplicate scaling.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.ConflictBy: Another mod already scales this by quality (Harmony ID: {0}). This adapter leaves it unchanged to avoid duplicate scaling.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.NativeCurve: The stat already has a native quality curve or custom worker/part. Its existing provider keeps control.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.NotApplicabl: This item does not use a supported native consumer. Turret gun definitions use turret cooldown only and are excluded from both weapon cooldown effects.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.CombatAvaila: Uses the actual weapon cooldown, native turret burst cooldown or damaging-trap stat. Native attack damage, accuracy, cooldown factors and trap variance remain in control.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.CeMissing: Needs Combat Extended, which is not loaded.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.CeNative: Combat Extended already scales these stats by quality. Tick the take-over option to use this mod's strengths instead.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.CePartial: Scales the Combat Extended stats in this group that have no quality curve yet. The rest keep Combat Extended's own curve unless this effect takes over.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.CeAvailable: Scales Combat Extended item stats. A higher factor is always better: stats where lower is better, such as recoil, are divided by it.
